rules.credits.title: Your credits
rules.credits.intro: The co-op runs on time, not money. One hour of babysitting for one child is worth 1 credit. You earn credits by babysitting for other members and spend them when someone babysits for you.
rules.credits.start: When you join, you get {amount} credits to get started.
rules.credits.floor: Your balance never goes below 0. At 0 credits you can't post a request until you've babysat and earned some.
rules.pricing.title: What a request costs
rules.pricing.time: The time is counted in blocks of {minutes} minutes. A request costs the hourly rate for the number of children, plus any extras.
rules.pricing.firstChild: The first child costs 1.00 credit per hour.
rules.pricing.secondChild: A second child adds {rate} per hour.
rules.pricing.otherChildren: Each child after that adds {rate} per hour.
rules.pricing.familyHouse: Babysitting at the requesting family's house adds {amount} credits.
rules.pricing.transport: Pick-up or drop-off by car adds {oneWay} credits one way, or {roundTrip} for a round trip.
rules.pricing.meals: Meals are charged per child: lunch {lunch}, dinner {dinner}, snack {snack}.
rules.pricing.exclusive: Transport can't be combined with babysitting at the requesting family's house.
rules.pricing.example: {children, plural, one {# child} other {# children}} for {minutes} minutes, {location}
rules.requests.title: Posting, claiming and cancelling
rules.requests.post: When you post a request, its cost is set aside (held in escrow) from your balance.
rules.requests.lead: A request must start at least {lead} after you post it.
rules.requests.claim: Members can claim a request until {cutoff} before it starts. The first member to claim it gets it, and it expires if nobody does.
rules.requests.payout: When the start time arrives, the credits go to the sitter.
rules.requests.cancel: You can cancel a request, and a sitter can withdraw a claim, any time before the start time. The credits go back to you in full.
rules.demurrage.title: Staying active
rules.demurrage.why: Credits are meant to be used, so they slowly fade for members who stop taking part.
rules.demurrage.charge: If you haven't completed a request, as requester or sitter, in more than {days} days, {amount} credits are taken from your balance every {day} at {time} ({zone}) until you take part again.
rules.demurrage.activity: Posting, claiming or cancelling doesn't count as taking part. Only a request that was completed does.
rules.demurrage.floor: Only your available balance is charged, and never below 0. Credits held in escrow are safe.
rules.demurrage.dormancy: After {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} without taking part, the co-op's Admin may get in touch to check in.
